answer: Re-attestations are stored in atlas and glacier lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ferrous graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1833 impostors cost 1362 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
